_comment: Cross-language parity fixture for wasted-island terrain (TerrainSampler.WastedTerrainAt backend / wastedTerrainAt frontend): for each seed, every hex within `radius` of (centreQ, centreR) - a window around the smallest wasted island of the default-size world - whose wastedTerrainAt is land, sorted by (q, r). Generated by scripts/regen-goldens/wasted-terrain-golden.ts from the frontend generator; WastedTerrainGoldenTests.cs (backend) and wastedTerrain.golden.test.ts (frontend) each recompute against this fixture using their own production sampler and assert the frozen `hexes` list.
